content.short: Merkl runs onchain incentive programs, defining eligibility rules and routing rewards to participants.
content.description: Merkl lets protocols specify who qualifies for an incentive and then distributes rewards to those addresses, instead of paying every liquidity provider the same regardless of how useful their position was. Targeting incentives is how projects avoid renting liquidity that leaves the moment emissions stop.
content.meta: Targeted incentive programs that reward useful positions rather than paying every LP the same.
